description: Born-bounded install resource budgets (BI-4F3AB6B3). Single source of truth for compose limits, WSL host ceilings, and the release gate that blocks uncapped always-on services.

postgres.rationale: Primary system of record; bound to leave host headroom under concurrent builds.

portal.rationale: Next.js production runtime; largest always-on app process.

dpf-tts.notes: BI-A0A0568F: keep profile-gated; do not promote to always-on. Idle-process elimination is the preferred long-term path.
